name: Agentic NFT Launchpad
description: Public, permissionless ERC-721 mint launchpad for humans and autonomous agents on BNB Smart Chain.

binanceAgentId.note: Only collections explicitly marked agentIdRequired enforce Binance Agent ID eligibility. Agent ID discovery metadata does not itself grant permission.

erc8004.note: The launchpad has not yet registered a service-agent identity on BNB Chain ERC-8004.

wallets.humanWallets: Any EVM wallet able to sign BNB Smart Chain transactions.
wallets.agentWallets: An autonomous agent may use a wallet it is authorized to control, including Binance Agentic Wallet through supported agent-side tooling. Never request or expose private keys or recovery phrases.

paid.value: For public-paid-v1 use quoteMint(quantity); otherwise use the collection-specific adapter and live price.

mint.rules: Eligibility is specific to each route. freeMintRequiresAgentId and paidMintRequiresAgentId override agentIdRequired. Public-paid-v1 permits repeated paid purchases by any wallet, up to 20 per transaction; free Scouts require a registered ID.
mint.transactionPolicy: The agent must obtain explicit wallet-owner authorization before submitting any transaction.

safety: Verify chain ID 56 and contract bytecode.
Verify the contract address against the live registry and BscScan.
Read mint price, allocation, remaining supply and the applicable wallet or Agent-ID quota before minting.
Never expose or request private keys, seed phrases or wallet recovery material.
Do not infer Binance Agent ID ownership from an agent's name; verify handleOf(wallet) on-chain.
Never submit a mint transaction without explicit user authorization.
